title: 小鹏IRON机器人明年先去门店当导购
title_en: Xpeng's IRON robot to start as a store guide next year
blurb_en: Xpeng says its IRON humanoid robot will enter mass production in January 2027, intern as a sales guide in its Chinese stores in Q1, and launch officially in Q2 2027.
